lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is positioned posterior to the gills, arranged in approximately five horizontal rows with centroids spaced at regular intervals across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal feature on the upper flank is characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side and a shadow-induced low-intensity gradient below.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region and the pectoral fin exhibit a significantly higher density of smaller, more irregular high-luminance clusters compared to the larger, ordered blobs on the lateral flank.
